evidence_quotes: Bij besluit van 17 oktober 2017 heeft de raad het bestemmingsplan "Giethoorn" vastgesteld.
rationale: The Raad van State summary states only that the municipal council adopted the general zoning plan ('bestemmingsplan "Giethoorn"'). On the available decision text, this is a municipal land-use/zoning decision under general spatial planning law with no mention of the Waterwet, waterschap governance, flood defence, waterways, or water/wastewater utility services. Under Protocol Rule 1, general non-water zoning decisions are classified as NOT_WATER (not_water_related); confidence is medium because the one-sentence RvS inhoudsindicatie identifies the contested zoning plan without detailing individual grounds of appeal.
